criteria.notes: The published package drives both map modes, directory selection, route guidance, and the newly authored You are here artwork as a complete replacement marker.
Northline geometry, graph topology, assets, calibrated route data, camera framing, and the custom origin marker remain sourced from the editable Studio project.
The architectural map, branded upright origin marker, persistent spatial labels, route flow, arrival treatment, and directory form a purpose-built wayfinding experience.
Primary headings, map labels, directory rows, route steps, and the custom marker remain legible at Full HD and 1366x768 without clipped text or artwork.
Light and dark kiosk chrome retain clear hierarchy and control contrast; the authored floor plate and custom marker stay distinct in both themes.
Destination and status text clamp safely, the directory uses bounded scrolling, and selected details fit without control, label, or marker overlap.
The map remains dominant at both supported sizes; the camera-facing 3D marker and aspect-correct 2D marker occupy their anchor without obscuring destinations.
The wbmap supplies coordinated map media plus one custom origin asset. Its full artwork replaces the default core in 2D and the default mesh in 3D while the separate beacon remains clean.
Semantic 2D, extruded 3D, package-driven custom markers, graph directions, and spatial controls remain materially distinct from dashboard and editorial examples.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD 3D is nonblank and balanced; the custom origin badge is upright, camera-facing, unobstructed, and anchored by a restrained ground beacon.
Compact 3D preserves the full control hierarchy and keeps the custom marker recognizable without crowding room labels.
The repeated primary scenario confirms stable camera framing, marker scale, and map-to-directory balance.
The repeated compact scenario has no clipped controls, panel collision, artwork distortion, or horizontal overflow.
Dark theme preserves strong contrast for headings, controls, rows, active toggles, map labels, and the custom origin artwork.
Selected 2D clearly shows the route and details; the 2:1 custom marker is aspect-correct, fully replaces the default center dot, and remains separated from its pulse beacon.
